project_type: npm-workspaces TypeScript monorepo. The backend is Express 4 with better-sqlite3 11.10 (packages/backend, CommonJS). The frontend is React 18 with Vite 5 (packages/frontend). Shared types and zod schemas live in packages/shared. infra/ is a separate AWS CDK v2 npm project (aws-cdk-lib 2.271.0 in its lockfile) and is not a workspace.
language: TypeScript 5.x (Node 24.13.0 locally, Node 20 in the Docker image)
build_system: Root `npm run build` builds three workspaces in order. (1) shared: tsc. (2) backend: `tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-assets.js`; the script copies src/db/migrations/*.sql into dist, so a new .sql file needs no change; tsconfig excludes src/**/*.test.ts but compiles src/test/*.ts. (3) frontend: `tsc -b && vite build`. A fresh checkout needs @urbani/shared built before backend tests run (`npm run build --workspace @urbani/shared`). infra/ needs its own `npm ci`; infra/node_modules is absent today. Root package.json aliases: seed = `npm run seed --workspace @urbani/backend`; migrate likewise. There is no root reset alias: use `npm run reset --workspace @urbani/backend`.
test_framework: vitest 2.1.9 (packages/backend/vitest.config.ts): include src/**/*.test.ts, setupFiles src/test/setup.ts, fileParallelism false, one isolated module graph per file. supertest 7 is available. Tests use freshTestDb() from src/test/testDb.ts: in-memory SQLite plus setDbForTesting plus runMigrations. Fresh-config pattern: snapshot process.env, set vars, vi.resetModules(), await import('./index'), restore in finally (see src/integrations/index.test.ts).

key_patterns: Registry pattern: src/integrations/index.ts (getIntegrations / setIntegrationsForTesting / resetIntegrations, cached module singleton); the new src/repositories/index.ts copies it. Repositories become factory closures (no `this`) returning async interfaces from repositories/types.ts. SQLite methods keep their SQL and db.transaction bodies verbatim with no internal await, and call getDb() per method. Errors: AppError subclasses in src/lib/errors.ts are mapped to { error: { code, message, details, correlationId } } by middleware/errorHandler.ts with no change; the new PersistenceError extends AppError. Config: zod schema in src/config/index.ts, validated at import, fail-fast with 'Invalid environment configuration: - VAR: msg'. Logging: src/lib/logger.ts writes JSON lines (warn/error to stderr, info to stdout) and is gated by LOG_LEVEL. Routes use asyncHandler plus zod schemas. Services return Sourced<T> envelopes. Callers use `const repos = getRepositories()` inside each function and await every call. CLIs: `if (require.main === module)` blocks. The new db/cli.ts imports config only via await import() so config errors exit 2.
